hook: orphan 增長團看計數器：burgeon／proliferate／augment／accrete——園丁說「長太快也要修剪」。
script: burgeon／proliferate 激增。augment 增加。accrete 漸增。wax 增強。mushroom 迅速發展。口令：溫室寫「可控生長」，野草寫「別 proliferate 到走廊」。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 嫩芽爆: burgeon walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「嫩芽爆」出場：burgeon 一上場梗就黏住——迅速成長。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 加厚: augment walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「加厚」出場：augment 一上場梗就黏住——增加。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 月盈: wax walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「月盈」出場：wax 一上場梗就黏住——增強。
members.vocabNote: 留在幽默庫作構詞／劇本用；暫不列入 GRE 難詞主庫，避免稀釋考點密度。

members.senseAnchor: any new growth of a plant such as a new branch or a bud; a newly grown bud (especially from a germinating seed)
